answer_points: They have chlorophyll / chloroplasts, which absorb (sun)light.
They carry out photosynthesis, in which water reacts with carbon dioxide (a word or symbol equation is accepted).
worked_example.question:
Some small plants are growing in the ground between the trees in a woodland. The leaves of the small plants are green.

Describe how these plants make glucose.
worked_example.tip: Any two of the four points earn the two marks: chlorophyll or chloroplasts, photosynthesis, absorbing light, water reacting with carbon dioxide.

key_idea: Plants and algae make their own food by photosynthesis. Carbon dioxide and water react to make glucose and oxygen. The reaction is endothermic: it takes in light energy, absorbed by chlorophyll in the chloroplasts.

blocks.text: Photosynthesis is a chemical reaction. This section covers what goes in, what comes out and how to write it.

items.meaning: The reaction in plants and algae that makes glucose and oxygen from carbon dioxide and water, using light energy.
The green substance that absorbs light for photosynthesis.
The part of a plant or algal cell that contains chlorophyll, where photosynthesis happens.

Know the symbols CO₂, H₂O, C₆H₁₂O₆ and O₂.

blocks.text: Photosynthesis needs energy. This section covers where the energy comes from and where the reaction happens.

items.meaning: A reaction that takes in energy from the surroundings.

items: The energy is transferred from the environment to the chloroplasts by **light**.
Chlorophyll in the chloroplasts absorbs (traps) the light.
Algae also photosynthesise, because they have chlorophyll.
Photosynthesis is endothermic: it takes in energy.
The energy comes from light, absorbed by chlorophyll in the chloroplasts.

sections.heading: An endothermic reaction in the chloroplasts

blocks.text: Photosynthesis is how energy from light enters living things. This section covers why plants and algae matter to every food chain.

items.meaning: An organism that makes its own food, here by photosynthesis.

items: Plants and algae are the main **producers** of food on Earth.
The glucose they make is used to build their biomass.
Other organisms get their food, and so their biomass, from plants and algae.
Photosynthesis also releases oxygen. When the number of algae in a river rises, the dissolved oxygen concentration rises.
Photosynthetic organisms are the main producers of food and biomass.
Algae photosynthesise too, so they add oxygen to water.
